protocol.scope: Model 1b ten-minute per-mode offsets only; all 40 route patterns, classifier, calibration temperature, top-K=5, destination features, horizons and alert rules frozen
protocol.validation_partition: Whole time blocks separated by >1800 s; first two blocks for fresh-model early stopping, last three for ranking. Gap exceeds 600-second horizon.
protocol.warm_start_caveat: Continuation preserves the source's original seed-0 internal random holdout and identical training data, as required by sklearn warm_start. Fresh refits use explicit earlier chronological validation. This legacy internal split is reported, not presented as a new chronological training control.
protocol.selection: Rank by trajectory guards then fixed combined error/coverage objective on later validation only; validation alert-chain veto determines eligible candidate. If none pass, audit the best trajectory candidate as rejected diagnostic, never adopt.
protocol.trajectory_guards: Errors <= baseline*1.02 + .01 NM or 1 ft or .001 energy; coverage drop <= .5 pp; regimes n>=100: mean error <=+5%+.01 NM and top1 within5 drop <=1 pp. Earlier horizons must be identical.
protocol.alert_guards: No loss in real detections, three-minute catches, real tier1, prominent early real conflicts; no increase in total false alerts, false tier1, collapsed real, or prominent false plus false tier1.
protocol.confirmation: Fresh-refit winner: repeat training seeds 1 and 2. Warm continuation is deterministic from a fixed seed-0 source and cannot claim independent multi-seed replication.
protocol.test_policy: Freeze candidate from validation before opening historical test targets. Later Sep10/Sep20 cohort is shared with prior LSTM studies and is an exploratory audit, never used for ranking.
protocol.energy_score: Lower-is-better beta=1 energy score of normalized top-five mixture in local residual coordinates scaled by 5 NM along/cross and 1000 ft altitude. Scaling is our design. Not the full forty-class distribution or conflict risk.
protocol.git_policy: No commits or pushes without Archit's explicit instruction. Current study is local and uncommitted.

guardrail_failures: regime vertical/gentle climb/descent: mean error >5% or hit drop >1 pp
regime vertical/fast climb/descent: mean error >5% or hit drop >1 pp
regime distance to VABB/terminal: mean error >5% or hit drop >1 pp

route_classification.note: Route-cluster calibration; not calibration of within-distance hits or conflict probabilities. Frozen for every candidate.
